endpoints.name: Create ZaloPay Order
endpoints.description: Registers a new transaction with ZaloPay, returns the payment URL and qrCode, and transitions order status to PENDING.

responseBody.paymentUrl: String (URL to open ZaloPay payment page)
responseBody.qrCode: String (ZaloPay order URL for QR generation)

endpoints.name: ZaloPay Callback Webhook
endpoints.description: Asynchronous webhook endpoint called by ZaloPay gateway to confirm transaction success. Verifies MAC signature, applies row-level pessimistic locking, revalidates stock, and updates order/cart.

requestBody.data: String (JSON string representing transaction details, verified with signature)

responseBody.return_code: Integer (1 for success, -1 for validation error)

endpoints.name: Query Transaction Status
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current transaction state from ZaloPay gateway and applies state transitions locally.

endpoints.name: Cancel ZaloPay Transaction
endpoints.description: Allows users or scheduling systems to cancel a pending ZaloPay transaction, releasing the lock/order.
